Choosing a program

Choose a program that fits your goals

What would you like to be able to do?

Think about a specific skill you want to practise, such as cooking a dish or preparing a presentation. Use that goal to compare program descriptions, outcomes, and requirements.

What kind of time can you give it?

A workshop, a program, and a consultation can ask for different kinds of commitment. Read the full schedule, not only the first date. Check whether you need equipment or practice time, and choose online or in person around the skill and your circumstances.
